description: This Java source file defines the TaxClassController class, a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing tax class entities within a web application. It includes methods for listing, paging, saving, updating, removing, and editing tax classes, with security annotations and AJAX response handling.

classes.name: TaxClassController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing tax class CRUD operations with security and AJAX support.

methods.name: displayTaxClasses
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of tax classes for a merchant store.

methods.name: pageTaxClasses
methods.description: Handles POST requests to return paginated tax class data in JSON format.

methods.name: saveTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new tax class after validation.

methods.name: updateTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing tax class after validation.

methods.name: removeTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a tax class, with checks for associations.

methods.name: editTaxClass
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load a tax class for editing.
